nodes.summary: If $F$ is a finite field with $q$ elements, then the projective general linear group $\mathrm{PGL}_2(F)$ has order $q(q^2 - 1)$.
nodes.title: Order of $\mathrm{PGL}_2$ over a finite field

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements whose characteristic $p$ is not $2$. Then the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_2(F)$ has order $q(q^2 - 1)/2$.
nodes.title: Order of $\mathrm{PSL}_2$ over a finite field of odd characteristic

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $K$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbb{F}_p$. Every finite nontrivial subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{PGL}_2(K)$ whose order is not divisible by $p$ is cyclic, or isomorphic to the dihedral group of order $2n$ for some $n \ge 2$, or isomorphic to one of the groups $A_4$, $S_4$, $A_5$.
nodes.title: Dickson's classification, tame case

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $K$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbb{F}_p$, and let $G$ be a finite subgroup of $\mathrm{PGL}_2(K)$ whose order is divisible by $p$. Then at least one of the following holds. (a) There are natural numbers $m \ge 1$ and $t$ with $t$ coprime to $p$ and $t \mid p^m - 1$, and an injective homomorphism $\varphi$ from the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}/t\mathbb{Z}$ to the automorphism group of…
nodes.title: Dickson's classification, wild case

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, $K_p$ denotes a fixed algebraic closure of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Algebraic closure of the field with p elements

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $F$ be a field of characteristic $p$. If an element $g$ of $\mathrm{PGL}_2(F)$ has finite order and $p$ divides the order of $g$, then the order of $g$ is $p$.
nodes.title: Elements of $\mathrm{PGL}_2$ of order divisible by the characteristic

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, $\mathrm{PGL}_2(K_p)$ is the quotient of the group $\mathrm{GL}_2(K_p)$ of invertible $2 \times 2$ matrices over the algebraic closure $K_p$ of $\mathbb{F}_p$ by its center.
nodes.title: Projective general linear group of degree two

nodes.summary: Let $f : R \to S$ be an injective homomorphism of commutative rings and let $n$ be a finite index set. Then the homomorphism $\mathrm{PGL}_n(R) \to \mathrm{PGL}_n(S)$ induced by applying $f$ to matrix entries is injective, where $\mathrm{PGL}_n(R)$ denotes $\mathrm{GL}_n(R)$ modulo its center.
nodes.title: Injective ring maps induce injective maps of $\mathrm{PGL}_n$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, $\mathrm{PSL}_2(K_p)$ is the quotient of the group $\mathrm{SL}_2(K_p)$ of $2 \times 2$ matrices of determinant $1$ over the algebraic closure $K_p$ of $\mathbb{F}_p$ by its center.
nodes.title: Projective special linear group of degree two

conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
